description: This file is a TypeScript script that validates the format and content of files within the 'agents/' directory, specifically checking rule files for proper frontmatter and the knowledge base for correctly formatted sections.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Interface representing validation error details with file and message.

classes.name: RuleFrontmatter
classes.description: Interface representing the frontmatter fields of a rule file.

methods.name: parseFrontmatter
methods.description: Parses YAML frontmatter from file content, returning frontmatter object and body.

methods.name: validateRuleFile
methods.description: Validates a rule file for proper frontmatter structure and required fields.

methods.name: validateKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Checks the knowledge-base.md for sections that do not start with 'When...'.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates validation of rules and knowledge base files.
